# GTM Growth

> Open-source workspace for evidence-led SEO/GEO, analytics, local presence, Social, commerce and observed CRM journeys. Apache-2.0; self-hosted software is free.

## Start here

- [Website](https://gtm.kayroslab.com/): diagnose, understand, act, measure and grow
- [Site français](https://gtm.kayroslab.com/fr/): the same content and journey in French
- [Marketing guide](https://gtm.kayroslab.com/guides/marketing/): decisions, useful outputs and measurement limits
- [Technical guide](https://gtm.kayroslab.com/guides/technical/): architecture, scoped access and integration prerequisites
- [Guide marketing FR](https://gtm.kayroslab.com/fr/guides/marketing/)
- [Guide technique FR](https://gtm.kayroslab.com/fr/guides/technical/)

## Interpretation

Public page readiness is not measured AI visibility and does not grant private Google data access. Buyer questions are reviewed hypotheses, not measured demand. Aggregate analytics do not establish contact identity. Provider setup, permissions and independent approvals remain necessary. Solo €39/month and Agency €149/month are pilot hypotheses; checkout and subscription entitlements are inactive.
